facts.fact: The Central Bank of Nigeria issued a circular ordering all banks, payment service providers, mobile money operators and fintechs to store and manage all domestic payment transaction data inside Nigeria by 1 January 2027, covering ledgers, audit logs, disaster-recovery backups and encryption keys.
facts.system: CBN circular on domestic payment transaction data

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Nigeria issued the circular on in-country storage of domestic payment data for the banks and payment firms it regulates, which the article says face regulatory sanctions after 1 January 2027.
facts.system: CBN circular on domestic payment transaction data
